reason: The first campaign fit-gate review exposed that a contiguous 35-arcsec score-mask segment can contain multiple geometrically distinct source passages. This successor restores the previously validated event identity before another real fit is inspected.

support.event_completeness: reject a half-power block touching either retained scan edge
support.window_combination: union overlapping accepted event windows within one detector-scan for the numerical objective; preserve every event identity for visualization
support.mask_intersection: fixed event windows intersected with the base frozen 35-arcsec score mask and validity mask

model_contract.amplitude: one profiled nonnegative amplitude per retained detector-scan
model_contract.baseline: reuse the base fitter's off-source constant baseline; source-crossing samples never train it

visualization_contract.individual_unit: one accepted half-power crossing event, never one broad score-mask segment
visualization_contract.required_context: show the full local event window, objective support, nearby excluded samples, tau-zero and fitted trajectories, fitted model, and residual
visualization_contract.required_census: show accepted and rejected event counts and rejection reasons

interpretation.permitted: point estimates, objective profiles, deterministic event and scan diagnostics
interpretation.prohibited: formal significance, causal identification, universal correction, or release of the remaining campaign before owner review of ObsNum 150818
